VALIDATION_FAILED: Fix the invalid values and try again
RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests — try again shortly
CONFLICT: There's a conflict with the current state
LIMIT_REACHED: You've reached the limit for this action
AGENT_EXECUTION_FAILED: Unable to reach the device's agent
AGENT_TIMEOUT: The device didn't respond in time
SCHEME_NOT_ALLOWED: This remote-access link isn't allowed by policy
INVALID_CUSTOM_FIELD_VALUE: One of the custom field values is invalid
RACE_LOST: Someone else already handled this request
RE_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED: This device needs to be re-enrolled
SOFTWARE_INVENTORY_LOCK_TIMEOUT: Software inventory update is busy right now — try again shortly
TICKET_TRIAGE_DISABLED: AI triage suggestions are turned off for this organization
TICKET_TRIAGE_UNAVAILABLE: No AI triage suggestion is available for this ticket right now
TICKET_TRIAGE_PRIORITY_MISMATCH: The suggested priority has changed — review it again before applying
TICKET_TRIAGE_CATEGORY_MISMATCH: The suggested category has changed — review it again before applying
MAILBOX_RECONSENT_REQUIRED: This mailbox needs to be reconnected to keep syncing tickets
ASSIGNEE_NOT_FOUND: The selected assignee could not be found
ASSIGNEE_PARTNER_MISMATCH: The assignee must belong to the same partner as the ticket
tool_source_unavailable: This tool's source is currently unavailable
ai_not_configured: AI isn't configured on this server. An administrator needs to add a model provider key.
ACCESS_REVIEW_SELF_DECISION: You can't decide on your own access — another administrator must review this item
PARTNER_GROUP_TARGET_UNSUPPORTED: Partner-wide device groups can only be targeted by partner configuration policies
PARTNER_GROUP_READ_ONLY: This partner-wide device group can't be changed here
PARTNER_GROUP_FILTER_UNSUPPORTED: Partner-wide device groups cannot be used in group filters, and their filters cannot reference groups or organizations
SCAN_ALREADY_QUEUED: A scan is already queued for this device.
PORTAL_INVITE_CONTACT_NOT_FOUND: That contact no longer exists or is not available to you.
PORTAL_INVITE_CONTACT_NO_EMAIL: This contact has no email address. Add one first.
PORTAL_INVITE_EMAIL_MISMATCH: The invite email must match the contact's email address.
PORTAL_INVITE_CONTACT_CONFLICT: This email address already has a portal login linked to a different contact. Unlink it first.
PORTAL_INVITE_LOGIN_EMAIL_DIFFERS: This contact's portal login uses a different email address. Update the contact's email or unlink the login first.
PORTAL_INVITE_ALREADY_ACTIVE: This person already has an active portal login.
PORTAL_INVITE_USER_DISABLED: This person's portal login is disabled. Re-enable it instead of inviting again.
PORTAL_INVITE_EXTERNAL_IDENTITY: This email belongs to a Microsoft Entra sign-in only. A browser portal invite cannot be sent for it.
